brief:
Children in Gaza continue flying paper kites despite widespread devastation from Israeli military operations that has destroyed homes and displaced families across the territory, according to IMEMC News. The kites represent a form of play and normalcy for young Palestinians who have lost their houses, schools, and possessions in the conflict.

Children who lack safe spaces and permanent homes have turned to flying kites as a means of engaging in childhood activities. The practice persists across Gaza despite the rubble and ongoing insecurity surrounding them.

title: Gaza children fly kites amid destruction from Israeli operations
